_what: D187: kvflow-prefetch on the D164 FINAL workload (tag _L3_epg_rq30, posted knobs). Three proofs gating the KVFLOW_CELLS list: the PORT RULE on this workload, off-switch identity, and a name proof through run_live2_real.py itself.
_register: DRY decision-path cells, stub bridge, no engine, no server. Every number here is a COUNT OF DECISIONS or a digest, never seconds; nothing here is a measured latency, quality or capacity result. `prefills_issued` is an OBSERVED COUNT of release_piece/release_whole rows in the coordinator's own decision log (arms_kvprefetch.py:603). The `prefetch_*` figures are the arm's ASKS, one per promoted session per epoch, most of which no-op; they are NOT a decision count and must not be reported as one.
_tree: every cell ran on a CLEAN checkout containing ONLY what is committed at d0675b6338a10ef4cc91c90cb9993c92eecc8a15, built with `git archive`, NOT in the shared worktree, which carries other sessions' uncommitted edits.

_concurrency.note: stated because host load is a parameter of this dry harness (d184_r3_wallclock_probe.json). The positive control was run ALONE and reproduces its committed digest exactly, which is the one direction a dirty or perturbed tree cannot fake.

_standing_caveats_on_every_dry_row: NO MEMORY LIMIT IS ENFORCED in a dry cell (the standing caveat recorded in research/STATUS.md on every dry row). These cells run at FULL (1x) memory by the harness's default pool, and nothing here measures behaviour under KV pressure.
DRY means the stub bridge and NO engine and NO server, so no cache of any kind is consulted and there is no warm/cold distinction to state: no latency is measured at all.
Host load is a parameter of this dry harness (d184_r3_wallclock_probe.json). Concurrency is recorded per proof and the headline cell was re-run in a separate process.

consistency_check.2_physical_plausibility: NOT APPLICABLE AND SAID SO RATHER THAN SKIPPED: every number in this file is a COUNT OF DECISIONS or a digest. No latency, throughput or size is measured or reported, so there is no implied rate to compare against the committed cost curves.
consistency_check.3_distribution_sanity: The port rule is a COUNT ON ONE CELL, which is the register the task asks for, so no median over items is reported and none should be read in. The count is NOT a suspicious constant: it is corroborated by a second, independent route (the arm's own prefetch_ahead_emitted = 99 equals the observed 108 minus the base's 9), and the cell was re-run in a separate process as a cross-run reproduction control. The per-seed spread across seeds 4 to 7 is NOT claimed here and will come from the live cells.

consistency_check.5_claim_linkage: Bears on the spec v6 section 10 baseline comparison: whether kvflow-prefetch is a fair representative of its published system on the final workload. It SUPPORTS running it, and it WEAKENS any reading of the arm as fully expressed, because 19,107 of 19,209 asks are still refused. Nothing here measures KV transfer between heterogeneous tiers, which FORMULATION.md Scoping puts out of scope.
consistency_check.6_proxy_validity: NO PROXY IS USED for the port-rule count: it is an OBSERVED count of rows in the coordinator's own decision log, not a stand-in. The arm's `prefetch_*` counters WOULD be a proxy for the decision count and are deliberately NOT used as one; they are reported separately and labelled ASKS.
consistency_check.7_validate_the_control: DONE, and it is the reason the positive control exists in this file: the committed `kvflow` base was audited against its own committed numbers BEFORE the off-switch comparison was read, and reproduced all four of them exactly. A broken control passes every check applied to the treatment.
